Use.name: New Year's Day
Use.as: Day of the Establishment of the Slovak Republic

NotableDate.name: Day of Our Lady of Sorrows

Rule.name: fixed-sep-15-sk
Rule.comment: Sedembolestná Panna Mária. Feast of Our Lady of Sorrows, patroness of Slovakia, observed on 15 September.

Rule.name: fixed-may-08-sk
Rule.comment: Deň víťazstva nad fašizmom. Marks the end of the Second World War in Europe on 8 May 1945.

Rule.name: fixed-jul-05-sk
Rule.comment: Sviatok svätého Cyrila a Metoda. Honors the Byzantine missionaries who brought Christianity and literacy to the Slavs.

Rule.name: fixed-aug-29-sk
Rule.comment: Výročie Slovenského národného povstania. Commemorates the 1944 uprising against Nazi Germany and its collaborators.

Rule.name: fixed-sep-01-sk
Rule.comment: Deň Ústavy Slovenskej republiky. Marks the adoption of the Constitution of the Slovak Republic on 1 September 1992.

NotableDate.name: Struggle for Freedom and Democracy Day

Rule.name: fixed-nov-17-sk
Rule.comment: Deň boja za slobodu a demokraciu. Commemorates the student demonstrations of 1939 and 1989 against totalitarian rule.
